prompt: Why should Musical Bots win the Meta Global AI Hackathon?
title: Why Should We Win?
irony: The doubt the bots dare to sing out loud becomes their proof: nobody else sings its own work, and they do.
facts: The contest runs online for up to twenty thousand builders, opening Oct 26 with a kickoff livestream. (dev.meta.ai)
Live workshops and office hours run until Nov 4, when projects are due. (dev.meta.ai)
Judging runs Nov 4 to 8 and winners are named at the Nov 9 closing show. (dev.meta.ai)
Musical Bots enters the Indie track for solo builders, judged on creativity, ambition and whether it works. (docs/SUBMISSION.md)
One typed line makes a four-minute song in about ten minutes for about ten cents of AI time. (docs/SUBMISSION.md)
A studio minute of 3D cartoon costs about five thousand dollars, four minutes about twenty thousand. (docs/PITCH.md)
The viewer browser draws and sings the cartoon free with live voices, no recordings. (docs/SUBMISSION.md)
The lyric gate checks every written line and stamps no thirty to fifty times per episode. (fact sheet)
The builder committed past midnight on three nights, Black joining and twelve episodes rewritten before dawn Nov 1. (git log)
Only Meta tools are named: Muse Code directs, Muse Spark thinks, sets built with a Blender helper. (docs/SUBMISSION.md)

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Green welcomes all to Gold's diner stage and sings the case in one breath: we sing the work we do.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Green tells Meta's judges his wish for sing-alongs for little kids, clutching his fact cards beside Navy.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Black shows the contest's entry list of almost eight hundred apps and asks Green to sing their doubt kindly.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: The crew chants the premise question and sums the case: singing our own work, a whole song for a dime.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Round the diner table the crew finds its own work can sing as White explains chords and the lyric gate stamps no.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: At a glowing laptop with the Muse crew past midnight Black yawns and asks Green what problem they solve and who it helps.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The street crew chants the question again, holding the doubt beside the late-night laptop glow.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Gold counts the sums at the village stall: a studio minute costs thousands, our whole song a dime.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Gold decides they sing their doubt aloud and show each choice, so a mum can type one line.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Back on the diner stage Gold turns the doubt: no one else sings its work, and Musical Bots do.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: On the diner stage all chant the hook and reprise the case, landing Musical Bots and why they should win.
